</body>
=======
<button id="atoms-export" class="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-40 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-lg">导出</button>
<script>
document.getElementById('atoms-export').addEventListener('click', function () {
  var data = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { var k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.indexOf('app:') === 0) data[k] = localStorage.getItem(k); }
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }));
  a.download = 'export.json';
  a.click();
});
</script>
</body>
